response.sql: WITH invoice_stats AS (SELECT ili.invoice_number, AVG(ili.derived_product_cost) as invoice_avg_product_cost, AVG(ili.derived_total_cost / ili.product_price) as invoice_avg_ratio FROM `Invoice_Line_Items` ili WHERE ili.derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL AND ili.product_price IS NOT NULL AND ili.derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL AND ili.product_price != 0 GROUP BY ili.invoice_number), overall_avg_ratio AS (SELECT AVG(invoice_avg_ratio) as overall_avg FROM invoice_stats), filtered_invoices AS (SELECT ist.invoice_avg_product_cost, ist.invoice_avg_ratio, oar.overall_avg FROM invoice_stats ist CROSS JOIN overall_avg_ratio oar WHERE ist.invoice_avg_ratio > oar.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(invoice_avg_product_cost) as avg_product_cost, AVG(invoice_avg_ratio) as avg_ratio, AVG(invoice_avg_ratio - overall_avg) as avg_above_overall FROM filtered_invoices
